note: Human-reviewed classification of Forever talents vs Classic Era. Each entry records the Forever max-rank tooltip it was checked against; if that text changes in a new beta build, the entry is ignored until re-reviewed.

104725.name: Purification
104725.checkedText: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 10%.

104730.name: Restorative Totems
104730.reason: Same effect; Healing Stream Totem bonus 25% → 50%.
104730.checkedText: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 25% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 50%.

104731.name: Ancestral Healing
104731.checkedText: Increases your target's armor value by 25% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

104736.name: Natural Grace
104736.reason: Same threat reduction, now for all spells.
104736.checkedText: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 15%.

104743.name: Stormstrike
104743.reason: Same idea: a weapon strike that boosts your next Nature damage by 20%, now tied to your own spells.
104743.checkedText: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

104747.name: Flurry
104747.checkedText: Increases your attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

104751.name: Improved Lightning Shield
104751.checkedText: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%.

104753.name: Thundering Strikes
104753.reason: Same crit bonus, now for spells and all attacks.
104753.checkedText: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.

104769.name: Elemental Devastation
104769.checkedText: Your offensive spell critical strikes will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 9% for 10 sec.

104772.name: Concussion
104772.reason: Same bonus; covers Earth Shock instead of all Shocks.
104772.checkedText: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 5%.

104914.name: Improved Rejuvenation
104914.checkedText: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 15%.

104916.name: Gift of Nature
104916.checkedText: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by 10%.

104920.name: Subtlety
104920.reason: Same threat reduction; now Nature and Arcane spells, 20% → 30%.
104920.checkedText: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by 30%.

104929.name: Nature's Reach
104929.checkedText: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and improves your chance to hit by 4%.

104931.name: Improved Moonfire
104931.reason: Same 10% bonus in 2 ranks instead of 5.
104931.checkedText: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 10%.

104936.name: Moonfury
104936.reason: Same 10% bonus, now for all Arcane and Nature spells.
104936.checkedText: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 10%.

104937.name: Moonkin Form
104937.reason: Same form, plus a stronger Omen of Clarity.
104937.checkedText:
Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form. While in this form, the armor contribution from items is increased by 360%, Omen of Clarity gains 100% increased chance to trigger, and all party members within 45 yards have their critical strike chance increased by 3%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack. The Moonkin cannot cast healing spells while shapeshifted.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

104939.name: Heart of the Wild
104939.reason: Same effect; Intellect and Cat Form Strength 20% → 10%.
104939.checkedText: Increases your Intellect by 10%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 20% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 10%.

104943.name: Feral Swiftness
104943.reason: Same bonuses; no longer limited to outdoors.
104943.checkedText: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%.

104946.name: Sharpened Claws
104946.reason: Same 6% bonus in 2 ranks instead of 3.
104946.checkedText: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 6%.

104952.name: Predatory Strikes
104952.checkedText: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by 150% of your level.

104958.name: Furor
104958.reason: Same Bear Form Rage; Cat Form now restores your previous Energy instead of granting 40.
104958.checkedText: Gives you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. When you shift into Cat Form, you will regain 100% of the Energy you had when you were last in Cat Form, plus 10 Energy for each second you spent not in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form, up to a maximum of 100 Energy.

104961.name: Bestial Wrath
104961.checkedText: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

104965.name: Spirit Bond
104965.reason: Same regeneration rate: 2% per 10 sec equals 1% per 5 sec.
104965.checkedText: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.

104967.name: Ferocity
104967.reason: Same pet crit bonus (15% → 10%), now also for hawks.
104967.checkedText: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 10%.

104968.name: Improved Mend Pet
104968.reason: Same cleanse, plus a Mana cost reduction.
104968.checkedText: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.

104969.name: Unleashed Fury
104969.reason: Same pet damage bonus (20% → 15%), now also for hawks.
104969.checkedText: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 15%.

104974.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
104974.reason: Same Dodge bonus (5% → 6%), and the pet now shares it.
104974.checkedText: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 6%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

104987.name: Surefooted
104987.reason: Keeps +3% hit; resist chance replaced by shorter movement impairing effects.
104987.checkedText: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.

104989.name: Counterattack
104989.reason: Same ability; damage changed from 40 to 50% weapon damage plus 26.
104989.checkedText: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

104994.name: Entrapment
104994.reason: Same root; now always triggers from all traps instead of a 25% chance.
104994.checkedText: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.

105002.name: Mortal Shots
105002.reason: Same effect and number (ranged crit damage bonus 30%).
105002.checkedText: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.

105004.name: Trueshot Aura
105004.reason: Same aura; 50 attack power → 30 ranged attack power.
105004.checkedText: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yards by 30. Lasts 30 min.

105009.name: Efficiency
105009.checkedText: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.

105011.name: Lethal Attacks
105011.reason: Crit bonus now applies to all attacks, not just ranged.
105011.checkedText: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 5%.

105321.name: Holy Power
105321.reason: Same +5% crit, plus extra crit for Holy Shock and Holy Strike.
105321.checkedText: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by 15%, and all other spells by 5%.

105329.name: Illumination
105329.reason: Same effect; refunds 50% instead of 100% of the base cost.
105329.checkedText: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, Light's Vigil, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain Mana equal to 50% of the base cost of the spell.

105331.name: Unyielding Faith
105331.reason: Resist chance replaced by shorter Fear/Disorient durations.
105331.checkedText: Reduces the duration of Fear and Disorient effects on you by 30%.

105333.name: Healing Light
105333.reason: Same bonus, now also covers Holy Shock.
105333.checkedText: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light, and Holy Shock spells by 12%.

105334.name: Improved Seals
105334.reason: Same bonus, now covers all Seals and Judgements (5 → 3 ranks).
105334.checkedText: Increases the damage done by your Seals and Judgements by 15%.

105626.name: Redoubt
105626.reason: Same block bonus; triggers on melee hits (10% chance) instead of after being crit.
105626.checkedText: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 30%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

105628.name: Holy Shield
105628.checkedText: Increases chance to block by 20% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

105630.name: Toughness
105630.checkedText: Increases your armor value from items by 10%.

105638.name: Precision
105638.reason: Hit chance now applies to all attacks, not just melee weapons.
105638.checkedText: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

105693.name: Vengeance
105693.reason: Same Physical and Holy damage bonus after crits, now a 3% stack for 30 sec (5 → 3 ranks).
105693.checkedText: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 3 times.

105711.name: Improved Kidney Shot
105711.reason: Same idea: stunned targets take 9% (all sources) → 10% (your poisons and attacks).
105711.checkedText: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

105720.name: Murder
105720.reason: Same damage bonus; 2% vs four creature types → 4% vs Humanoids and Giants.
105720.checkedText: Increases all damage dealt by 4% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

105722.name: Malice
105722.reason: Same crit bonus, now also for Poisons.
105722.checkedText: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.

105723.name: Remorseless Attacks
105723.reason: Same effect and numbers; the list now includes the new Mutilate.
105723.checkedText: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 40% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

105728.name: Blade Flurry
105728.checkedText: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

105736.name: Endurance
105736.checkedText: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.

105737.name: Precision
105737.reason: Same hit bonus, now for all attacks; 5% → 3% (5 → 3 ranks).
105737.checkedText: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

105743.name: Premeditation
105743.reason: Same ability; combo points last 20 sec instead of 10.
105743.checkedText: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

105752.name: Serrated Blades
105752.reason: Same effect; armor ignored is now a flat 9% instead of scaling with level.
105752.checkedText: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

105753.name: Elusiveness
105753.checkedText: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

105754.name: Ghostly Strike
105754.reason: Same ability, with extra damage when a Dagger is equipped.
105754.checkedText: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

105755.name: Initiative
105755.checkedText: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

105763.name: Winter's Chill
105763.reason: Same debuff; the bonus now applies to Ice Lance and Frostbolt instead of all Frost spells.
105763.checkedText: Gives your Frost damage spells a 100% chance to apply the Winter's Chill effect, which increases the chance your Ice Lance and Frostbolt spells will critically hit the target by 2% for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.

105768.name: Shatter
105768.reason: Same 50% bonus in 3 ranks instead of 5.
105768.checkedText: Increases the critical strike chance of all your spells against Frozen targets by 50%.

105771.name: Improved Blizzard
105771.checkedText: Adds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec.

105776.name: Permafrost
105776.checkedText: Increases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%.

105799.name: Arcane Instability
105799.checkedText: Increases the damage done by your spells by 3% and your critical strike chance by 3%.

105804.name: Improved Counterspell
105804.reason: Same effect: Counterspell always silences for 4 sec.
105804.checkedText: Your Counterspell also Silences the target for 4 sec.

105808.name: Arcane Geometry
105808.reason: Replaces Magic Attunement with an unrelated effect.
105808.checkedText: Increases the range of your Arcane spells by 6 yards.

105809.name: Arcane Resilience
105809.checkedText: Increases your Armor by an amount equal to 50% of your Intellect.

105810.name: Arcane Concentration
105810.checkedText: Gives you a 10% chance of entering a Clearcasting state after any damage spell hits a target. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

105812.name: Arcane Subtlety
105812.checkedText: Reduces your target's resistance to all your spells by 15 and reduces the threat caused by your Arcane spells by 30%.

105818.name: Darkness
105818.checkedText: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

105824.name: Silence
105824.checkedText: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

105846.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
105846.checkedText: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.

105848.name: Silent Resolve
105848.reason: Still reduces threat (now Holy spells, 30%), plus shorter Stun/Fear/Silence.
105848.checkedText: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.

105852.name: Spiritual Healing
105852.reason: Same 10% bonus in 3 ranks instead of 5.
105852.checkedText: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 10%.

105853.name: Spiritual Guidance
105853.reason: Same effect; the spell damage part drops from 25% to 8% of Spirit.
105853.checkedText: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

105860.name: Inspiration
105860.checkedText: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 25% for 15 sec.

105861.name: Blessed Recovery
105861.reason: Same heal, with an extra trigger for big hits.
105861.checkedText: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 25% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

105866.name: Improved Renew
105866.checkedText: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 15%.

105878.name: Pyroclasm
105878.checkedText: Gives your Soul Fire spell a 26% chance to Stun the target for 3 sec, and your Rain of Fire and Hellfire spells a 26% chance over their duration to Stun targets they damage for 3 sec.

105886.name: Aftermath
105886.reason: Destruction spells no longer Daze; Immolate gets more damage and only Conflagrate Dazes.
105886.checkedText: Increases the initial damage of your Immolate spell by 50% and your Conflagrate spell has a 100% chance to Daze the target, reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

105889.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
105889.reason: Same 20% Shadow vulnerability, now a flat 12 sec from your attacks instead of 4 charges.
105889.checkedText: Your Shadow Bolt critical strikes increase Shadow damage taken by the target from your attacks by 20% for 12 sec.

105905.name: Improved Health Funnel
105905.reason: Same bonus (20% → 40%), plus lower cost and no threat.
105905.checkedText: Increases the amount of health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by 40%, reduces its health cost by 30%, and reduces all threat your Health Funnel generates by 100%. Allows Health Funnel to be used regardless of your demon's health.

105907.name: Demonic Embrace
105907.reason: Same Stamina bonus; the Spirit penalty is gone.

105908.name: Improved Imp
105908.reason: Same bonus for Firebolt and Fire Shield; Blood Pact no longer included.
105908.checkedText: Increases the damage of your Imp's Firebolt spell by 30% and the effect of its Fire Shield spell by 30%.

105910.name: Shadow Mastery
105910.checkedText: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells by 5%.

105914.name: Nightfall
105914.reason: Same proc, from more spells (Drain Soul, Wrack).
105914.checkedText: Gives your Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life, and Wrack spells a 4% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

105919.name: Improved Bane of Agony
105919.reason: Same bonus (curse renamed to Bane); 6% → 10% (3 → 2 ranks).
105919.checkedText: Increases the damage done by your Bane of Agony by 10%.

105925.name: Suppression
105925.reason: Still improves hit (5% for all spells instead of 10% for Affliction), plus 20% less threat.
105925.checkedText: Improves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%.

105927.name: Death Wish
105927.reason: Same +20% Physical damage and Fear immunity; the drawback changed to +5% damage taken.
105927.checkedText: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

105928.name: Flurry
105928.checkedText: Increases your melee attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

105930.name: Bloodthirst
105930.reason: Damage formula changed and the heal-on-hit effect was replaced by movement speed.
105930.checkedText: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 35% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

105934.name: Blood Craze
105934.reason: Same heal, with more triggers (Bloodthirst, big hits).
105934.checkedText: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike, dealing damage with Bloodthirst, or suffering more than 20% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

105938.name: Booming Voice
105938.reason: Still increases the shouts' area by 50%; the duration increase was dropped.
105938.checkedText: Increases the radius of your Battle Shout and Demoralizing Shout abilities by 50%.

105954.name: Improved Tactical Mastery
105954.reason: Still retains Rage on stance change; part is now baseline and the talent adds up to 15.
105954.checkedText: Tactical Mastery lets you retain up to an additional 15 Rage when you change stances.

105956.name: Improved Rend
105956.reason: Same effect and numbers; only capitalization differs.
105956.checkedText: Increases the Bleed damage done by your Rend ability by 35%.

105973.name: Toughness
105973.reason: Same effect and numbers; only capitalization differs.
105973.checkedText: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

105974.name: Improved Bloodrage
105974.reason: Same effect (more Rage from Bloodrage), different amount.
105974.checkedText: Increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability by 50%.

105978.name: Improved Berserker Rage
105978.reason: Still generates 10 Rage, and now also removes movement impairing effects.
105978.checkedText: Your Berserker Rage ability will instantly generate 10 Rage and has a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when activated.

110874.name: Shield Specialization
110874.reason: Same absorb bonus, plus mana on block.
110874.checkedText: Increases the amount of damage absorbed by your shield by 30%, and gives your blocks a 100% chance to restore 6% of your maximum Mana. May only occur once every 3 sec sec.

105813.name: Improved Channeling
105813.reason: Same channeling protection for Arcane Missiles, now also 70% for Arcane Blast.
105813.checkedText: Gives you a 100% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while channeling Arcane Missiles and a 70% chance while casting Arcane Blast.

105820.name: Vampiric Embrace
105820.reason: Same party healing (duration 1 min → 30 sec), plus an extra effect.
105820.checkedText: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. Vampiric Embrace also grants a chance for your Spirit Tap talent to trigger when enemies afflicted by it die.

105788.name: Improved Scorch
105788.reason: Same effect; rank 2 is rounded 67% instead of 66%.
105788.checkedText: Your Scorch spell has a 100% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Fire damage. This vulnerability increases all Fire damage you deal to your target by 3% and lasts 30 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
